# 101 Codecrafts

> 101 Codecrafts is a tech learning and collaboration community based in Kampala, Uganda: courses and learning paths, coding practice, projects, hackathons, events, mentorship, daily tech news and opportunities, for learners from Primary school to professionals.

Public pages are listed below. Courses, practice, the library, AI tools and the marketplace open after a free sign-in, so they are not listed. Prices are in Uganda shillings (UGX); payments are by MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money or card.

## Main pages

- [101 Codecrafts](https://site-url.invalid/): Your IT journey starts here: learning paths, free courses, skill-building workshops, hackathons, mentorship and certification support, in Kampala and online.
- [About 101 Codecrafts](https://site-url.invalid/about.html): 101 Codecrafts is a tech learning community in Kampala, Uganda: coding, AI, data, cybersecurity, cloud, projects, hackathons and mentorship for every level.
- [Community: study groups, meetups and hackathons](https://site-url.invalid/community.html): The 101 Codecrafts community: study groups, events and meetups, hackathons, member projects and the Launchpad. Free to join.
- [Daily Tech News for Uganda and Africa](https://site-url.invalid/news.html): Today in tech: Africa & Uganda, AI, dev and startups — short AI summaries with links to the original sources, curated daily for the 101 community.
- [Tech Events & Meetups in Kampala and online](https://site-url.invalid/events.html): Tech events in Kampala, Uganda, Africa and online: hackathons, GDG DevFest, Microsoft, AWS, Hugging Face and 101 Codecrafts meetups. Times in East Africa Time.
- [Scholarships, internships and tech jobs](https://site-url.invalid/opportunities.html): Scholarships, internships, jobs, hackathons, grants, fellowships, competitions and bootcamps for students and young techies in Uganda and Africa.
- [Plans and pricing in UGX](https://site-url.invalid/pricing.html): Learner and tutor plans: Free, Standard, Plus and Pro, priced in Uganda shillings. Pay with MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money or card. External courses stay free.

## Optional

- [Verify a certificate](https://site-url.invalid/verify.html): Check that a 101 Codecrafts certificate is genuine: enter the code printed on it, in the format 101-XXXX-XXXX.
